'''Item Rarity Support''' is a [[support gem]] that increases the [[rarity]] of items dropped by [[monster]]s when they are killed using the supported skill.

==Skill functions and interactions==
The [[rarity]] bonus from this gem applies to enemies killed by [[damage over time]] effects sourced by linked skills. Poisons/ignites inflicted by {{psl|Master Toxicist}}, {{il|Bino's Kitchen Knife}}, {{il|Berek's Respite}}, or {{il|Abberath's Hooves}} will not be supported by Item Rarity support, but will use the players generic IIQ/IIR modifiers.<ref>{{cite web|author=Chris|date=January 29, 2014 11:06 PM|title=1.0.6 Patch Notes|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/777247|publisher=Path of Exile Forum|accessdate=February 17, 2014}}</ref><ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/xb7ygt/comment/io2hwfd/</ref> 

The degeneration effect that is first applied to a monster is responsible for its death<ref>https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/xb7ygt/comment/ioc3gl5/</ref>. So, if '''Item Rarity''' is used with multiple sources of damage over time (like {{il|Essence Drain}} + {{il|Contagion}}), it should be linked with the skill that is cast first (assuming both the initial Contagion and Essence Drain are still applying to the enemy when it dies).

When linked with a skill that creates a [[minion]], [[trap]], [[mine]], or [[totem]], the item rarity [[modifier]] does apply to kills made by the minion/trap/mine/totem. This includes deaths caused by [[Minion Instability]] explosions.

Since the {{c|mod|increased Rarity of Items}} only applies on kill, combining this gem with {{il|Culling Strike Support}} can be useful when using multiple skills, or while playing in a [[party]], as it increases the chances of the linked skill being the one that lands the kill.
